text:
leah: quick thread on routing SLA: propose fallback-on-delay + sticky-owner restore. keep SDR notified.
omar: ok but make threshold per-connector. some partners take longer.
tay: data: p95 enrichment 11s, p99 26s. recommend default threshold 15s.
leah: workflow sketch:
```
if enrichment_time > THRESHOLD:
  route -> fallback_queue
  tag owner_sticky=<id>
  send slack+email to owner
```
dev-bot: deploy checklist created: hs-workflow PR, sf-field PR, canary 10% for 24h, monitor owner_reassign_rate and sdr-notify-fails.
ops-sre: we'll watch metrics and be oncall first 6h. rollback if owner_reassign_rate > 1% or SDR reopen rate spikes.
leah: small ask for analytics: emit event routing.degrade.enter/exit with connector and account_segment tags.
omar: I'll draft HS workflow and email copy. Tay will add metrics dashboard.
leah: thanks all, post PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
